verdict.rationale: The evidence documents general REST and Graph read-write access to files, lists and driveItems, but nothing about creating or revoking sharing links, or setting visibility, password or expiry on them. Generic CRUD on files is an adjacent building block, not the sharing-link capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, sharing is programmable — shared links with visibility, password, and expiry settings can be created and revoked via the API
